marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Designed to encourage children at Key Stage 1 to learn and recognise monetary values and handle money in everyday situations. Colourful graphics, animations and spoken instructions throughout make this program ideal for unsupervised use in the classroom. The activities will help encourage purchasing items using the correct coins, develop recognition of different coins, practice converting between differing amounts of money, giving correct change and recognising prices in a shop, including on a shopping list. Also included are five different currencies to choose from, a teacher setting area and a collection of printable worksheets.
